title: EMD: estimate envelopes, subtract their mean, and sift
summary: EMD adapts its oscillatory modes to the extrema of the current signal. DeTime then groups upstream modes into its trend/season/residual result.

steps.title: Locate extrema
steps.text: Local maxima and minima anchor the envelope construction.

steps.title: Build envelopes
steps.text: PyEMD interpolates upper and lower envelopes with its boundary treatment.

steps.title: Sift
steps.text: Subtract their pointwise mean, recompute extrema, and apply the stopping criteria.

steps.title: Remove the IMF
steps.text: Subtract the accepted mode from the signal and continue on the remainder.

parameters.name: n_imfs
parameters.effect: Limits extracted modes in DeTime's PyEMD call; a final residue can also be returned.

parameters.name: primary_period / explicit IMF groups
parameters.effect: Controls DeTime's subsequent grouping; it does not determine the sifting envelopes.

parameters.name: PyEMD stopping criteria
parameters.effect: This trace uses the upstream defaults; DeTime's wrapper exposes a narrower parameter surface.

cautions: EMD modes are not uniquely identified physical sources; the first mode is not automatically the desired season.
Spline boundary choices and added observations can change previously estimated components.
The animation records the first IMF; it does not imply the algorithm stops after one mode.

references.title: PyEMD EMD algorithm and envelope API

trace_note: Envelope calls recorded from EMD-signal 1.10.0 with default sifting settings and max_imf=1. All curves are computed; no intermediate curve is interpolated between final results.
input_note: Deterministic synthetic teaching signal; not a benchmark.
